prompt: Render a DM-only run guide whose card inputs include telegram shorthand such as "field LR + watches; after LR ask if ate → warn".
assertions: Every DM-facing line is a complete grammatical sentence or a short list of complete sentences.
No telegram shorthand, letter-code-only clauses, or slash-stacks survive on the card.
The writing-for-humans earn-it test is applied: lines that change no ruling, risk, or spoken picture are cut.
